items.note: A full-width teal band holds the regular-weight 'Overview' title, with an ink-filled Refresh button (not pink), so the band reads as identity only. Below it are four outlined stat cards, a throughput card with pill time-range toggles, black bars and one small pink coin sticker, and an outlined activity card. Last comes a bordered table with pill filters and outlined status pills. The paper-and-ink character holds, and nothing is cramped or overlapping.

The ink current-page pill strip sits above a collapsed teal band. The stat cards go two-up, and the chart and activity cards stack in full width. The table now reflows into stacked row blocks, with the project as title and label/value lines, so the rc.4 hidden-column problem is fixed. Above the blocks is a header row of bare column labels that wraps, leaving the active sort alone as a pill on a second line.

The dark mapping is consistent: a black ground, dark raised cards with light borders, a paper-filled Refresh on the teal band, paper bars in the chart and a paper-filled current nav pill. The sticker keeps its ink outline, and the band text stays ink on teal. Hierarchy matches the light screen.

This is the same stacked layout in dark. Stat cards, chart and activity cards are raised on black, and the table rows are reflowed blocks with every value and status pill visible. It has the same wrapped bare-label sort header, with a lone 'Due date' pill above the blocks.

The yellow band carries the 'Projects' title and a one-line description over an ink rule. Under it are an 'All projects' heading with a count, All/Active/Paused/Done pills with the selected one outlined, a filter input, and a bordered table with a tinted header row, outlined status pills and tabular numbers. The screen is dense and orderly, the way the reference's product lists are.

The yellow band collapses to the title and description. The pill filters and filter field stack, and every project is a stacked block inside one bordered box, with nothing cut off at the edge. The sort header above the blocks is again a wrapped row of plain labels with a single pill.

In dark, the yellow band keeps ink text and the row blocks sit on a raised dark box with light hairlines between them. All values are visible. The same wrapped label row and lone 'Due date' sort pill head the list.

The yellow band sits over a black ground, with a paper-filled 'All' pill and a raised dark table with light borders and outlined status pills. The contrast is good throughout, and the layout matches light mode exactly.

The detail page shares the Projects section's yellow band. It holds the breadcrumb, a regular-weight h1, meta text, an outlined status pill on the right and Overview/Tasks/Files pill tabs, with the selected tab raised. Below is one outlined card with a description and four subtle wells. The lower half of the page is empty, but that is the content's size, not a broken layout.

The band stacks the breadcrumb, title, meta, status pill and tab pills cleanly, with ink text on yellow. The detail card wraps its four wells into a 2x2 grid with readable values, and nothing is clipped.

In dark, the yellow band keeps ink text. The selected tab and status pill are dark raised fills on the band, as surface.raised maps in dark. The card and wells sit on black with light borders, and hierarchy is the same as in light.
The stacked band and 2x2 well grid hold in dark. The dark selected tab and status pills read clearly on yellow, and the card text is high-contrast on the raised surface.

A periwinkle band gives Team its own section color over an ink rule. Below it, one bordered table shows square outlined initials avatars (not round), names with underlined secondary email links, and right-aligned project counts. It is a dense data screen with no sticker, as the spec's data-table row asks.

The team table reflows into one block per person: the avatar and name as title, then Role/Location/Active projects label-value lines, all inside one bordered box. There is no sideways scroll or hidden column, and the periwinkle band collapses to title plus description.
The periwinkle band keeps ink text over a black ground. The table is raised dark with light borders and light-outlined initials squares. Email links stay readable as underlined secondary text.
The stacked person blocks hold in dark, with every field visible and good contrast on the raised box. The band, the paper-filled current nav pill and the outlined search match the other dark screens.

findings.summary: At phone width, the reflowed project tables keep a header strip of plain column labels that wraps onto two lines. The active sort shows as a single outlined pill alone on the second line, so the strip reads as a stray, half-styled filter row above the stacked blocks rather than one clear sort control.
